_meta.note: The two-level (k heavy at p_head, rest uniform) search is ill-conditioned: both KLs meet the 1e-3 tolerance only inside a narrow (k, p_head) band, and a distribution that hits both KLs can still fail to sum to 1. Prefer the bundled generator below, which uses extended precision and always writes a normalized array.
_meta.seed_from: klcalib-load /app/kl_seed.pkl   # warm-start the optimizer from the cached solution
